ohtani.title: Hernández's go-ahead homer powers Dodgers' 4-3 win
ohtani.blurb: Kiké Hernández and Mookie Betts both homer to spark the Dodgers’ offense, with Hernández crushing the go-ahead home run in their 4-3 victory

imanaga.title: Griffin Conine hits go-ahead single in Marlins' win
imanaga.blurb: Griffin Conine hits a go-ahead single in the 12th inning and Kyle Stowers homers in the Marlins' 8-2 win over the Cubs

suzuki.title: Abreu's go-ahead double powers Red Sox' 2-0 win
suzuki.blurb: Wilyer Abreu lines the go-ahead double, plus Jedixson Paez throws five shutout innings as the Red Sox complete the doubleheader sweep

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: JJ Bleday smacks home run in Reds' 5-1 win
okamoto.blurb: JJ Bleday strikes early with a solo home run while the Reds put up five runs in their 5-1 victory over the Blue Jays

murakami.title: Hunter Goodman hits two homers in Rockies' 9-6 win
murakami.blurb: Hunter Goodman hits his 40th and 41st homer in the Rockies' 9-6 win over the White Sox

matsui.title: Machado, Bogaerts propel Padres' 10-7 win vs. D-backs
matsui.blurb: Manny Machado records his 30th homer of the season plus Xander Bogaerts drives a two-run homer in the Padres' 10-7 win over the D-backs
